headline: Approved a $7,400 McGrath estimate for work and the 2027 calendar dates.
summary: The financial report shows an investment of $150,661.32 as of September 2026. Repairs to monuments were discussed, with hopes that some get done before cold weather. A complaint dated November 2 about a grave stone was also listed.
decisions: Approved the McGrath estimate of $7,400 for work, which is waiting to be completed.

decision_evidence.quote: McGrath estimate of $7,400 is approved — just waiting on work to be completed.
